description:
Compares two DOCX files and returns a compact `@@ Word Patch @@` diff — Adeu's token-level, sub-word patch format — of their text content. Useful for analyzing differences between versions before editing.

Pass `output_path` (and optional `author_name`) to also write the comparison as a tracked-changes .docx of original_path in one step — the recommended way to make a redline between two versions; never hand-build compare batches. All or nothing: if any change cannot be tracked, nothing is written. output_path may not be either input. [Adeu v4.1.0+dadbcd3]

author_name.description: Author name for tracked changes when output_path is provided (default: 'Comparison').

compare_clean.description: If True, compares 'Accepted' state. If False, compares raw text.

modified_path.description: Absolute path to the modified DOCX file.

original_path.description: Absolute path to the baseline DOCX file.

output_path.description: Optional path to save a redlined DOCX showing all changes from original_path to modified_path as native Word tracked changes.

reasoning.description: Why do I need to diff these two documents? State this reason before any other parameter.

name: diff_docx_files
